text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kokura Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару offers her prayers at
Dazaifu
Tenmangu, one of the two most
sacred sites in
Fukuoka.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then makes a promise with me—we'll
visit the
second sacred spot if she
manages to get through
the Kokura
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
More motivated to race than ever,

Matikanefukukitaru heads to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
